indicator: Emergency Department Wait Time for Physician Initial Assessment
dimension: Health system outputs: Access to comprehensive, high-quality health services
interpretation: The 90th percentile of this indicator represents the maximum length of time that 90% of patients waited in the ED for a physician initial assessment.
description: This indicator measures the time interval between the earlier of triage date/time or registration date/time and the date/time of physician initial assessment in the emergency department (ED).

indicator: Total Time Spent in Emergency Department for Admitted Patients
dimension: Health system outputs: Access to comprehensive, high-quality health services
interpretation: The 90th percentile of this indicator represents the maximum length of time that 90% of patients admitted from the ED spend in the ED.
description: This indicator measures the time interval between the earlier of triage date/time or registration date/time and the date/time when a patient is admitted and leaves the emergency department (ED).

indicator: Cost of a Standard Hospital Stay
interpretation: This indicator is a measure of the relative cost efficiency of a hospital’s acute inpatient care. It compares total acute inpatient expenses with the number of weighted inpatient cases, resulting in the average full cost of treating an acute inpatient.
description: This indicator measures the ratio of a hospital's total acute inpatient care expenses to the number of acute inpatient weighted cases related to the inpatients for which the hospital provided care.

indicator: Patient Days in Alternate Level of Care (Percentage)
interpretation: The proportion of days a patient was assigned to the ALC patient service in a hospital.
description: The proportion of days a patient was assigned to the alternate level of care (ALC) patient service.

indicator: Hospitalized Seniors at Risk of Frailty
dimension: Health system inputs and characteristics: Efficient allocation of resources
interpretation: Higher levels of frailty are linked to a number of adverse outcomes among seniors. When frailty severity increases, so does the risk for these adverse outcomes.
description: This contextual measure quantifies the proportion of seniors at risk of frailty in acute care hospitals across Canada.

dimension: Health system inputs and characteristics: Health system resources
interpretation: A higher occupancy rate indicates higher utilization of acute care hospital beds.
description: The percentage of acute care hospital beds that are occupied by patients, averaged over the year.

indicator: Average Length of a Hospital Stay (Days)
interpretation: The average number of days a patient stayed in hospital
description: The average number of days a patient stayed in a hospital

indicator: Average Acute Care Resource Use Intensity
interpretation: The average relative cost weight value derived from patient-specific case-cost data
description: The sum of the Resource Intensity Weight (RIW) values divided by the total number of contributing cases.

indicator: Patients Admitted Through the Emergency Department
interpretation: The percentage of patients admitted through the hospital’s ED.
